_README: State-claim recheck hook snippet — TRACKED, so the registration arrives with a clone (every
.claude/settings*.json path is gitignored). Two halves of one hook, scripts/state_claim_recheck_hook.sh:
Stop             → the answer just given names «#N» next to a merge / permission / «morning» word and
the lease file (CLAUDE.local.md) has an «utterance» line naming #N → one pending note.
UserPromptSubmit → the pending note is injected once as additionalContext, then removed.
with the newer lease line present and no instruction, 5/5 relays repeated the stale state and opened
the file 0 times; an in-the-moment instruction gave 5/5 correct. A resident memory rule had no effect.
NEVER BLOCKS. exit 0 always; silent when there is no lease file, no match, or no python3.
NOT SHIPPED to npm consumers yet (not in package.json files[]) — the lease-file convention is this
hub's. Merge the hooks below into .claude/settings.json by hand or through install-wizard.
